law_name: Law No. 2005-30 of 5 April 2006 on the Protection of Copyright and Neighbouring Rights (repealed Law No. 84-008 of 15 March 1984)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (Art. 52); joint works from last survivor's death (Art. 53); anonymous works and audiovisual works 70 years from publication (Arts. 54-55); applied art 25 years (Art. 56)
fair_use_exceptions: Private family-circle and free educational performances (Art. 13); strictly personal and private reproduction, translation, adaptation of published works, excluding buildings, whole books, scores, databases (Art. 14); works in public places (Art. 18)
notes: Promulgation date varies (5 vs 10 April 2006); WCT accession 16 Jan 2006, in force 16 Apr 2006 (WIPO Lex); TRIPS from WTO membership lists; Berne/WPPT not verified; moral rights, digital protection not found

changes.to: Private family-circle and free educational performances (Art. 13); strictly personal and private reproduction, translation, adaptation of published works, excluding buildings, whole books, scores, databases (Art. 14); works in public places (Art. 18)
